Composite hydrograph — select wells to build one

Observation-year schedule

Only wells that were actually measured in the same periods as each other get averaged together — not just any well with data somewhere nearby. Auto-detect favors recent years (2000+, especially 2020+) when choosing which period to build the schedule around.

Schedule years

5-year bins

Defaults to the years actually covered by your current selection — not every possible bin. Remove bins you don't want, or add a custom one; a well qualifies only if it has a reading in every bin left below.

+ yr

Value shown

Elevation = each well's reference elevation minus its depth-to-water, so higher on the chart means more water. Only wells with a known reference elevation (~98% of sites) can contribute in this mode.

Normalize per well
(anomaly from each well's own mean)

Default shows the raw value in feet. Turn this on to instead show each well's departure from its own average — useful when combining wells with very different depths/elevations into one composite, since raw values would otherwise be dominated by whichever wells happen to be deepest or highest.
